clock_scope: Worker phase durations are end-start. Engine summaries use maximum rank duration per phase; initialize_plus_compile sums those two per-phase maxima, which is a summary, not a directly timed enclosing interval. Four-engine ranges differ from eight-worker extrema. Harness deploy wall is timeline deploy_start to deploy_end including RCM launch/supervision/return, excluding subsequent log collection, config acceptance and teardown. Controller elapsed_s is a narrower separately reported clock; neither is a sum of worker clocks.
cache_provenance: Every worker effective directory/threshold/entry-size/logging checked. Distinct run-named default/min0 directories reused only within their pair; raw first/warm listener events retained. No independent prelaunch empty-directory inventory exists in this audit; first-pass hits can occur after entries are written earlier in that same startup.
listener_scope: Counts are captured startup events across eight matched worker PIDs, including CPU-side loader and TPU work, not distinct executables, production inference misses, or eight independent experiments. Finished XLA compilation log durations include persistent-cache-hit paths/deserialization and are NOT compile-only time; no performance claim uses their sum.
limits: One fixed-order sequence default-1, default-2, min0-1, min0-2; one first/use-again pair per treatment.

No inference workload, token-equivalence check, full reconfiguration C or job makespan measurement.
Source/config correction alone was not performance evidence; this separate completed native campaign supplies the observed startup evidence.
Zero min0-2 persistent misses means zero matching events in captured startup logs, not zero future misses or zero compilation everywhere.
